name: thaloroot
description: Thaloroot: a whimsical, competitive, GM-less tabletop RPG, and its digital version.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @thaloroot/engine && npm run build -w @thaloroot/web && npm run build -w @thaloroot/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @thaloroot/engine && npm run typecheck -w @thaloroot/web && npm run typecheck -w @thaloroot/server
